design_philosophy.core_concept: Modern, minimalist, and deeply human. Move away from sterile, cold blue/white hospital tones. Emphasize trust, warmth, and accessibility in Ecatepec through organic colors, ample negative space, and a spa-like digital experience.

rules: Headings should have tight letter spacing.
Never center paragraphs, left-align for readability.
Overlines must be uppercase with wide spacing.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-12 to p-24) to create a 'breathing' UI that feels premium.

grid_system.services: Bento Grid Mode A ('Tetris'): Assymetric grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.

surfaces.nav: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-[#E5E1D8]/50
surfaces.cards: Subtle soft shadows, 1px #E5E1D8 border, no heavy soft-UI shadows.

components_instructions.navigation: Sticky nav (z-50) with logo, main links, and a solid CTA button. Crystal glassmorphism background.
components_instructions.hero: Hero section must have an organic feel. Split layout or large overlapping image. Max overlay bg-black/30 if text is placed over image. Use a soft, warm aesthetic.
components_instructions.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right. Not just an icon, a pill shape with text 'Agenda tu cita' for higher conversion, colored in WhatsApp green.
components_instructions.booking_form: Shadcn based. Stripped down minimal inputs (Input, Select) without heavy borders. Focus states must ring in brand primary.
components_instructions.maps: Embed Google Maps in the footer or contact section, styled cleanly, rounded corners.
components_instructions.buttons: Rounded-full for a modern, organic touch. High contrast text on hover.

hero_image.description: Smiling patient in a dental chair with healthcare professional nearby. Warm lighting.
hero_image.location: Hero Section background or split right image

dr_azael_authority.description: Professional and warm portrait of a dentist (representing Dr. Azael).

service_rehabilitation_lab.description: Dentist/technician creating artificial teeth in a modern dental lab.

service_aesthetics.description: Woman at a dental clinic smiling while holding a mirror.

guarantee_promise.description: Bright, clean, modern dental clinic equipment showcasing precision.

animations.entrances: Framer Motion: fade-up with slight Y translation (y: 20 -> 0) and high easing (ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]).
animations.hover: Scale down images slightly (scale: 0.98) on card hover to create depth.

testing.attributes: Add data-testid to all interactive elements, e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-cta', data-testid='booking-submit'.
